pairing_protocol: Render the post-control verification view once per seed/episode, then score all image and estimator stress conditions from that same frame and final physics state.
visual_effects_scope: Calibration offsets affect only back-projection. Exposure scaling is a uniform post-render brightness gain; occlusion removes marker-colored pixels with inpainting. These are controlled image stresses, not real-camera evidence.
quality_score_definition: The per-marker score is the minimum of normalized contour area, circularity, median saturation, and median brightness. The combined score is the minimum of the target and end-effector scores. This is a heuristic, not a calibrated probability.
